verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Svelte supports TypeScript: `lang="ts"` script blocks, `.svelte.ts` modules, and `sv check` reporting TypeScript compiler errors. However, nothing documents which TypeScript versions are officially supported or any compatibility policy. Stating supported language versions is a fair question for a UI framework, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence means none.

support.subject: As a developer, I know which TypeScript versions the framework officially supports so I can avoid compatibility breaks when upgrading either one
